French degree distinctions are translated descriptively and the original French mention is retained in parentheses.</div>

## Postdoctoral level

- **2024–2025** — Supervision of Cheyenne Dosso’s postdoctoral research within the MOVICI research project. Cheyenne Dosso holds a PhD in Cognitive Psychology and Human Factors / Human–Computer Interaction Ergonomics.

## Doctoral level

- **2022–present** — Co-supervision with Gérald Gaglio of Burhan Ozdemir’s PhD thesis: « L’appropriation de la technologie Blockchain par l’entreprise-réseau EDF dans l’accompagnement de la transition énergétique : les enjeux de la vie privée et de la confiance ».
- **2023–present** — Member of Vincent Berthier’s Individual Doctoral Monitoring Committee.
- **2022–present** — Member of Sylvain Juanes’s Individual Doctoral Monitoring Committee.
- **2021–2024** — Member of Luca Baccino’s Individual Doctoral Monitoring Committee. Thesis: « L’économie des infox : une extension théorique à l’économie des plateformes numériques et une application pour rationaliser la polarisation des croyances sociales liées à la crise COVID-19 ».
- **2020–2023** — Member of Adrian Candau’s Individual Doctoral Monitoring Committee. Thesis: « La médecine générale : évolution des contours d’un segment professionnel et approche sociologique de la décision médicale ».

## Undergraduate level

- **2020–2024** — Supervision of third-year Bachelor’s-level Sociology internship reports (average cohort: approximately 35 students per year).
- **2021–2024** — Supervision of one or two research projects per year undertaken by third-year Sociology–Economics dual-degree students for the final oral examination.
